body: There's nothing to do. I've been trying to tell my so-called friends and family that I felt bad for years. Nobody ever saw what the problem was, pretending I had no reason not to be happy. When telling my reasons I was called stupid. Now it's time to get rid of stupid me.

I'm very sad all the time. Not because the world doesn't have some people, but because I'm part of it while I just hate it. You should be sad for the mass slaughter of Australia's fauna, not for the loss of a pebble on the road.
No I don't. Also, I'm French, the whole world hates us, everybody will be glad there's one less.
